steps.name: 117 splash/F03.01/F03.02 × тема (Maestro, release APK)
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
APK='android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk'
AVD="ci117-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}"
PORT=5562
SERIAL="emulator-${PORT}"
AVDM="$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/avdmanager"
cleanup117() {
  adb -s "$SERIAL" emu kill >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  sleep 3
  pkill -f "qemu-system-x86_64.*-avd $AVD" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  "$AVDM" delete avd -n "$AVD" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
}
trap cleanup117 EXIT
echo no | "$AVDM" create avd --force -n "$AVD" \
  -k "system-images;android-36;google_apis;x86_64" -d pixel_7 >/dev/null
sed -i 's/^hw.ramSize=.*/hw.ramSize=2048/' "$ANDROID_AVD_HOME/$AVD.avd/config.ini"
adb start-server >/dev/null

# adb-транспорт эмулятора иногда кратко уходит в offline (PR #114, шаги 995 и 117:
# «device offline» / «device <...> not found» / DeviceServerDiedException). Ждём, пока
# adb стабильно отвечает на shell pm path android три проверки подряд.
wait_stable117() {
  local ok=0
  for _ in $(seq 1 40); do
    if [ "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state 2>/dev/null)" = "device" ] &&
       adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path android >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      ok=$((ok + 1)); [ "$ok" -ge 3 ] && return 0
    else
      ok=0
    fi
    sleep 2
  done
  echo "ОТКАЗ: эмулятор $SERIAL не стабилизировался (adb offline)" >&2
  return 1
}

boot_emulator() {
  emulator -avd "$AVD" -port "$PORT" -no-window -no-audio -no-boot-anim -no-snapshot \
    -gpu swiftshader_indirect >"emulator-$AVD.log" 2>&1 &
  adb -s "$SERIAL" wait-for-device
  for _ in $(seq 1 130); do
    [ "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')" = "1" ] && break
    sleep 3
  done
  [ "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')" = "1" ] || {
    echo "ОТКАЗ: эмулятор 117 не загрузился за 390 с" >&2; return 1; }
  wait_stable117
  for s in window_animation_scale transition_animation_scale animator_duration_scale; do
    adb -s "$SERIAL" shell settings put global "$s" 0
  done
  adb -s "$SERIAL" install -r "$APK" >/dev/null
}

# Прогон темы ровно один раз; при сигнатуре обрыва adb-транспорта в выводе темы —
# перезапуск эмулятора и второй (последний) прогон этой темы с чистым каталогом.
# Провал assert/assertVisible (rc≠0 без сигнатуры) — НЕ повторяется.
run_theme() {
  local theme="$1" night
  if [ "$theme" = "dark" ]; then night=yes; else night=no; fi
  adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd uimode night "$night"
  sleep 2
  rm -rf "maestro-out-117/$theme"
  set +e
  maestro --device "$SERIAL" test --format junit \
    --output "maestro-out-117/report-$theme.xml" \
    --test-output-dir "maestro-out-117/$theme" \
    .maestro/vkhod-117-splash-vhod.yaml
  local rc=$?
  set -e
  if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ] && grep -rqE 'device offline|device .* not found|DeviceServerDiedException' "maestro-out-117/$theme" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "ПОВТОР: обрыв adb-транспорта эмулятора — перезапуск и повтор темы $theme" >&2
    adb -s "$SERIAL" emu kill >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    sleep 3
    pkill -f "qemu-system-x86_64.*-avd $AVD" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    boot_emulator
    adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd uimode night "$night"
    sleep 2
    rm -rf "maestro-out-117/$theme"
    set +e
    maestro --device "$SERIAL" test --format junit \
      --output "maestro-out-117/report-$theme.xml" \
      --test-output-dir "maestro-out-117/$theme" \
      .maestro/vkhod-117-splash-vhod.yaml
    rc=$?
    set -e
  fi
  return "$rc"
}

boot_emulator
rm -rf maestro-out-117
for theme in dark light; do
  run_theme "$theme" || { echo "ПОВТОРЫ ИСЧЕРПАНЫ: тема $theme" >&2; exit 1; }
done

steps.name: 108 start (Maestro, release APK, свой эмулятор)
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
APK='android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk'
AVD="ci108-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}"
PORT=5568
SERIAL="emulator-${PORT}"
AVDM="$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/avdmanager"
KANON='device offline|adb: device not found|device [^ ]* not found|DeviceServerDiedException'
cleanup108() {
  adb -s "$SERIAL" emu kill >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  sleep 3
  pkill -f "qemu-system-x86_64.*-avd $AVD" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  "$AVDM" delete avd -n "$AVD" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
}
trap cleanup108 EXIT
echo no | "$AVDM" create avd --force -n "$AVD" \
  -k "system-images;android-36;google_apis;x86_64" -d pixel_7 >/dev/null
sed -i 's/^hw.ramSize=.*/hw.ramSize=2048/' "$ANDROID_AVD_HOME/$AVD.avd/config.ini"
adb start-server >/dev/null
boot108() {
  adb -s "$SERIAL" emu kill >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  sleep 3
  pkill -f "qemu-system-x86_64.*-avd $AVD" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  emulator -avd "$AVD" -port "$PORT" -no-window -no-audio -no-boot-anim -no-snapshot \
    -gpu swiftshader_indirect >"emulator-$AVD.log" 2>&1 &
  adb -s "$SERIAL" wait-for-device
  for _ in $(seq 1 130); do
    [ "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')" = "1" ] && break
    sleep 3
  done
  [ "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')" = "1" ] || {
    echo "ОТКАЗ: эмулятор 108 не загрузился за 390 с" >&2; return 1; }
  local ok=0
  for _ in $(seq 1 40); do
    if [ "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state 2>/dev/null)" = "device" ] &&
       adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path android >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      ok=$((ok + 1)); [ "$ok" -ge 3 ] && break
    else
      ok=0
    fi
    sleep 2
  done
  [ "$ok" -ge 3 ] || { echo "ОТКАЗ: эмулятор $SERIAL не стабилизировался (adb offline)" >&2; return 1; }
  for s in window_animation_scale transition_animation_scale animator_duration_scale; do
    adb -s "$SERIAL" shell settings put global "$s" 0
  done
  adb -s "$SERIAL" install -r "$APK" >/dev/null
}
zapusk108() {
  rm -rf maestro-out-start
  mkdir -p maestro-out-start
  set +e
  maestro --device "$SERIAL" test --format junit \
    --output maestro-out-start/report.xml \
    --test-output-dir maestro-out-start \
    .maestro/cmp-mob-004-start.yaml
  local rc=$?
  # 143 (Б-1 Rev143): БЕЗ set -e — errexit в функции глобален и
  # ронял шаг на ненулевом rc Maestro ДО ветки ДИАГНОСТИКА/ПОВТОР
  # (мёртвая ветка повтора; живой отказ — run 40961808157 att.1).
  return "$rc"
}
if ! boot108; then
  echo "ДИАГНОСТИКА 108: adb devices" >&2
  adb devices >&2 || true
  exit 1
fi
set +e
zapusk108
rc=$?
set -e
if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "ДИАГНОСТИКА 108: сигнатуры Maestro в maestro-out-start" >&2
  grep -rnE "$KANON" maestro-out-start >&2 2>/dev/null || true
  if grep -rqE "$KANON" maestro-out-start 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "ПОВТОР: обрыв adb-транспорта эмулятора 108 — перезапуск и повтор набора" >&2
    adb -s "$SERIAL" emu kill >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    sleep 3
    pkill -f "qemu-system-x86_64.*-avd $AVD" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    if ! boot108; then exit 1; fi
    set +e
    zapusk108
    rc=$?
    set -e
  fi
fi
[ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || exit "$rc"

# детей (CHTENIE_PUSTO) и каталог пуст — агрегат требует РОВНО
# множество выбранных id, пустое ≠ непустому выбору.
mkdir -p mobile/screen-evidence-collected
printf '%s' "$NEEDS_KONTEKST" > needs.json
node mobile/scripts/ci-aggregate.cjs --needs needs.json --evidence mobile/screen-evidence-collected

steps.name: Изоляция раннера (/home недоступен коду из PR)
Verify selected children
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
# Каталог доказательств обязан существовать (пустая matrix — ноль
# детей, CHTENIE_PUSTO; mkdir — страховка): агрегат судит пустое
# множество выбранных id, а не отсутствие каталога.
mkdir -p mobile/screen-evidence-collected
printf '%s' "$NEEDS_KONTEKST" > needs.json
node mobile/scripts/ci-aggregate.cjs --needs needs.json --evidence mobile/screen-evidence-collected

bodies.build-identity:
set -euo pipefail
APK='mobile/android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk'
test -f "$APK"
digest="$(sha256sum "$APK" | awk '{print $1}')"
imja="apk-${{ github.run_id }}-${digest:0:12}"
printf '%s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$digest" "${{ github.sha }}" "${{ github.run_id }}" "${{ github.run_attempt }}" "$imja" > mobile/build-identichnost.txt
{
  echo "apk_sha256=$digest"
  echo "artifact_name=$imja"
  echo "run_id=${{ github.run_id }}"
  echo "run_attempt=${{ github.run_attempt }}"
} >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
